summary: British American Tobacco p.l.c. filed a Form 6-K, which is a routine disclosure of transactions by persons discharging managerial responsibilities (PDMR) and persons closely associated with them. The filing reports that CEO Tadeu Marroco and Luciana Franco Do Amaral acquired 250 ordinary shares each at £42.890887 per share on August 25, 2026, as a reinvestment of dividend income. The shares are held in joint names. This is a routine PDMR notification under UK and EU market abuse regulations, corresponding to a standard SEC Form 4 for insiders, and does not involve any special-situation corporate action.
